title: Purchase manager rejects a waiting order with a reason: it goes back to RFQ and the purchaser sees why

seeds.name: poNumber
seeds.sql: SELECT o.Number AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o.Status = 'ToApprove' ORDER BY o.Number DESC LIMIT 1

steps.name: Open Purchase > Approvals and the waiting order's task
Reject without a reason: refused, the reason is asked for

textPresent: Give the purchaser a reason for the rejection.

steps.name: Reject with the reason 'Negotiate price': back in the inbox, the order no longer waits

outcome.label: the rejected order is an RFQ again and carries the manager's reason
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o.Number = '{{poNumber}}' AND o.Status = 'RFQ' AND o.ApprovalComment = 'Negotiate price'
